data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced adverse prior-year reserve development in 2019, with an unfavorable run-off deviation of $36.2m (gross) driven primarily by International Financial Lines and International Property & Casualty. This adverse development was partially offset by favourable reserve movements in Marine, Crisis Management, Energy Property and Wholesale Property & Casualty. Overall the net prior-year movement represented a modest strengthening of reserves (approximately 0.66% of the opening gross claims outstanding).
raw_causal_phrases: An unfavorable run-off deviation (prior accident years' deterioration) of $36.2m for Syndicate 2003 was experienced during the year driven from various lines of business.

The most significant contributors were International Financial Lines , International Property and casualty accounts due to unfavourable claims experience offset by the favourable movement on Marine , Crisis Management , Energy Property , Wholesale Property and Casualty.

The underwriting result in 2019 has benefitted from fewer catastrophe losses in comparison to previous years. Significant events during the year includes Hurricanes Dorian, Faxai, Hagibis and California Wildfires.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding was not explicitly stated. Opening reserves were calculated as Closing gross reserves (from the gross claims development triangle total = 5,703m) minus the reported gross change in provision for claims during the year ($236.999m), yielding ~5,466.0m. Prior year development ($36.2m) was taken from the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note (text). The report presents amounts in US dollars; all monetary fields here are reported in the native USD millions. Per-source confidence levels are provided above.
